Lucy — thanks for looping us in. A few technical clarifications to make the conformance run deterministic: 

1) Trace context format: do you use W3C Trace-Context (traceparent/tracestate) or a proprietary header? We prefer W3C for easiest span linking across services.
2) Span semantics: please confirm the top-level span you expect Redwood to emit (e.g., "redwood.request", with attributes: model, sequence_length, tokens_generated).

4) KV cache visibility: what keys/operations need to be surfaced in traces vs logs? We can surface cache hits/misses as events on the request span.
5) Test harness: does your harness run deterministic prompts for LangChain/LlamaIndex? If so, send the runner script; we prefer to automate the run via a small CI job.

If you can answer these items and drop the GitHub invite, we can provision a sandbox project and run the pass on Tue Apr 20 morning PT. If any of the items require code change in the SDK, please highlight those so we can plan time.

Thanks all — great questions. Quick answers and links below: 

- Trace format: we implement W3C Trace-Context (traceparent) across the SDK.
- Span semantics: top-level span name is "cw.sdk.call"; we will add a small mapping to accept "redwood.request" as an alias so your tooling can match existing dashboards. Attributes we emit: model (string), prompt_template_id, tokens_sent, tokens_received.
- Token attribution: we attach per-chunk attribution as span events rather than individual token spans (this keeps traces small). We'll include the hash of the token batch and a pointer to the attribution blob in S3 (read-only).
- KV cache: we'll emit cache.hit/cache.miss events on the top-level span and include the key namespace. No payloads are included.
- Test harness: repo is public at https://github.com/crosswalklabs/cw-sdk/tree/interop. Runner script is at tests/interop/run.sh and is deterministic — we added deterministic seeds.

We've attached updated conformance-checklist.xlsx and provided a repo invite for a small sandbox token (token-redwood-qa-readonly). We're available for a tech sync Mon Apr 19 10:00 PT or Tue Apr 20 09:30 PT — pick whichever works.

Next steps per MAP: Marissa to share marketplace pathing; Jonas to confirm sandbox provisioning; Sofia to share final MAP + timeline.

Thanks,
Lucy Hwang
Product Manager, Integrations
CrossWalk Labs
